title: Farm beds: rough, tilled, planted, ripe
oneLine: Each farm bed's dig/plant/water/feed/harvest cycle, ripe by a stored server-clock time; record carries a shape number.
topConcern: The record's shape number is computed from planted crops only; a future non-crop field must bump it by hand (documented).

title: Feed & Seed daily order board
oneLine: Three orders a UTC day, drawn once and stored; done flags are the replay guard; read fail-closed.
topConcern: Calls _farmOrderInFight directly, so the fightlock:false switch does not lift 'order-fight'; header's 'white skull keeps gold' reason is stale.

title: Food buff slots: one meal and one brew
oneLine: ps._buffs timers and magnitudes split into a meal slot and a brew slot, each cleared whole.
topConcern: A dish's buff-to-slot pairing is enforced by data and tests only (meals.test 147), not by _applyDish.

title: One bite at a time in a fight (heal clock)
oneLine: Room-level pvpAt/healAt stamps per player; instant heals held back within the fight window and gap.

title: Cooking a raw fish (cook_request)
oneLine: Client-graded cook outcome bounded by a rate window, a 900 ms floor and bot caps; hits plan for display.
topConcern: Client popup says +40 Cooking XP while the worker pays 200; refusal echoes use _sendPlayerState, a no-op on v2.

title: Predicted consume and refusal resend (eat, drink, cook recipe)
oneLine: Phone removes the item first; worker applies and echoes, or refuses and force-resends the predicted fields.

title: Gather node: alive, depleted, respawning
oneLine: A node's alive/respawnAt with a lazy tick respawn; deltas sent per changed id on v2, whole zone on v1.
topConcern: A node the phone predicted dead but the worker never changed is never re-sent on v2 (only changed ids go).

title: A harvest attempt: start, plan, strike
oneLine: The extraction record, hit plan, recovery clock and strike gates that decide whether a harvest is paid.
topConcern: Most strike refusals are silent: the phone keeps its predicted node fall and XP; the antibot-cap echo is a v2 no-op.

title: Harvest shield while gathering, cooking or lighting a fire
oneLine: Monsters ignore a harvesting player; derived each tick from ps.ex, the edge stamp, the record, node and range.
topConcern: Eight inputs from three machines; the cook/fire-before-record ordering is load-bearing and easy to break.

title: Life-skill levels and XP (server, mirrored on the phone)
oneLine: lifeSkills[skill]={level,xp} with the 1000x1.08^L curve; the phone predicts XP on harvests and gem sets.
topConcern: When the worker's lifeSkills does not change, the v2 echo omits it, so the phone keeps predicted XP and level banners.

title: Rate and cadence windows across the life skills
oneLine: Six time-gated limiters (farm, cook rate and floor, perfect claims, recovery strike, trap arms and catches).
topConcern: _trapRuntime entries are only dropped at a character reset; small, bounded by distinct trappers per room life.

title: Weapons in hand: three slots, the weapon bag, the active slot
oneLine: Equip/unequip/forge/set_active_slot over three weapon slots, an 8-weapon bag and the hand pointer.
topConcern: Client and worker reorder the bag differently, so a quick second equip can equip the wrong same-type weapon; fight-locked forge/harden/equip are open.

title: Gear provenance rows: minted, held, escrowed, in mail, legacy, forgotten
oneLine: Per-player ledger of minted armour/shield/amulet rows; derived sellability with eight reasons and about 13 writers.
topConcern: A stale second device re-adopts a sold piece as legacy (usable twin, documented); new mutations must remember _gearProvTouch.

title: Gear stash adoption at join (the open door)
oneLine: Every join merges the client's claimed armour/legs/shield/cosmetic lists by multiset union; a capture stamp records.
topConcern: Claims are shape-checked, never ownership-checked (documented); gearStashCaptured is a write-only flag nothing gates on.

title: The worn amulet: crafted, gem-slotted, never taken off
oneLine: ps.amulet replaced by each craft (old row kept), gem overwritten on a re-slot; nuggets and bars counters.
topConcern: Craft converts gold (forfeited in a No man's land loss) into a worn amulet (kept) with no fight lock or position check.

title: Gems move from the pouch to the bag (capture stamp, owed XP)
oneLine: Join-time heal moving lifeSkills.gems into bag keys; gemsCaptured one-time claim; gemsUnpaid owed set-XP.

title: Gem economy mode: crack and combine, or the old cut
oneLine: The shardcrack flag flips crack/combine, the old one-gem cut and the kill-roll raw gem together.

title: Weapon hardening: H0-H5, temper, pity or keep
oneLine: Per-weapon hardness and failure streak; hardenkeep switch chooses keep-on-failure or the temper pity band.
topConcern: hardenkeep thrown mid-session drops levels a page told the player a failure would keep (caps read at join).

title: Trap mark: armed, judged at the kill, rolled
oneLine: One trap mark per player on a Wheel monster for 15 s, judged at the killing blow, rolled per share.

title: Fish log and biggest-fish boards
oneLine: Per-player catches-to-weigh and bests, cached with dirty/locked flags; the room's per-species top-ten boards.

title: One-handed swords become greatswords
oneLine: Idempotent sword-to-greatsword conversion with a was mark, via migration v19 and four boundary doors.
topConcern: With swordconvert:false the Forge mints swords that no later door converts once the record's v19 migration has run.

title: Life-skill feature modes: flags read live, caps frozen at join
oneLine: About 29 live flags change server rules per message while each page keeps the caps it joined with.
topConcern: gearlevel thrown mid-session: page predicts an equip the worker silently refuses, and nothing puts it back.

title: A minted piece in flight: ledger and phone bag, not yet the server's list
oneLine: Forged, chest, dropped and quest armour live in the ledger and the phone's bag until the next join adopts them.
topConcern: forge_armor mid-fight turns forfeitable bars into armour a No man's land loss cannot take; no fight lock or position check.
